title: Placed tool catalogue
what: The tools the host serves, read from each tools root folder and from the registry pointers, reread when either changes so a put or take shows from the next call; retired versions swept once no call holds them. Lives in host/src/placed.rs.

title: Namespace serving
what: One namespace of tools as the MCP protocol serves it to a session whose record names it: entries the record names in shown listed by name, the rest booked into the toolbook, each call checked against the session grants. Lives in host/src/handler.rs and residency.rs.

title: Host HTTP refusals
what: The refusals the host answers before a request reaches a tool, on either face, each a non-2xx status with the common code and error body of the client. Lives in host/src/error.rs.

title: Tool schedules
what: The calls the host makes at the times each entry manifest declares in [[entry.schedule]], each under a record of its own, with where each schedule stands kept in the host process. Lives in host/src/schedule.rs.

title: Tool host
what: The mcp-host process: every namespace and the toolbook on the loopback port behind each tool session token, and the control socket routes behind the issuer token or a tool session token, paged by name or by time. Lives in host/src/server.rs and main.rs.

title: Session grants
what: A call runs only within the namespaces, capabilities and grants its tool session record carries: an entry declaring a grant resource runs where the record grants it, and the host asks no other unit. Lives in host/src/handler.rs.

title: Session records
what: The tool session records calls are served by, issued and revoked on the control socket with their expiry, one file each readable by the host user alone, named by its token hash and read back at start. Lives in host/src/records.rs.

title: Tool runner
what: How a placed tool is run: a process per call handed its call on standard input, or one MCP server per record, each in a clean environment laid from the host, the record variables and its variables file, with its own call-back socket and shared helpers. Lives in host/src/running.rs.

title: Toolbook
what: The server every harness configuration names beside its namespaces, listing, describing and calling the tools a session holds that its namespaces do not list, by the same dispatch a direct call takes. Lives in host/src/toolbook.rs.
